summary: Iteration 2 frontend-only retest: P0 Leaflet double-init bug FIXED, full broker flow verified, new Jade Haul branding verified end-to-end. All 11 critical flows pass with 0 console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Carrier risk badge component does not include 'badge' or risk-related className tokens — adding data-testid=carrier-risk-{level} on the badge would improve testability (visually OK).
Minor: Exception cards on /broker/exceptions lack a data-testid like 'exception-card-{n}' — would help automated assertion (visually OK).
Minor: /driver/jade chat input/send do not expose [data-testid=jade-chat-input]/[data-testid=jade-chat-send]; testing currently relies on placeholder text. Recommend adding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 confirmed P0 Leaflet double-init fix (StrictMode removed in index.js) and full broker flow. 0 console errors across all driver+broker routes. Three minor data-testid gaps noted (carrier risk badges, exception cards, jade chat input/send) — these are testability nits, functionality is intact and visually confirmed via screenshots.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous P0 RCA confirmed: React 19 StrictMode caused react-leaflet 4 to mount its <MapContainer> twice → Leaflet threw 'Map container is already initialized.' Fix: index.js no longer wraps the tree in <React.StrictMode>. Retest verified zero Map errors on /driver and /driver/gps.
